messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The team needs to train claims handlers on a new workflow.
  quote: We’re keen to get our claims handlers trained up on the new workflow.
- problem: The team cannot assign clear roles or automate document routing, so tasks are not tracked properly.
  quote: We need to assign clear roles and automate document routing — our current system doesn’t let us track tasks properly.
- problem: The customer has to manually draft letters for overdue claims, which is overwhelming.
  quote: can we automate letters for overdue claims? I’m swamped with manual drafting.
- problem: The customer needs to begin using the claims and document handling system promptly.
  quote: we’re really keen to get started with your system for handling claims and documents
- problem: Handlers spend hours on the phone each day instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
  quote: Every single day. We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
- problem: The company is handling claims and documents manually, which is no longer sustainable.
  quote: We’ve been managing claims and documents manually for years, and it’s becoming unsustainable.
- problem: They have to manually call each supplier to see garage repair progress, which interrupts their work.
  quote: We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
- problem: The team lacks built‑in visibility of garage progress and must make phone calls to get updates.
  quote: we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
